: AAAAAAHHHHH! YOU LIED TO CHINAMI! NOW, THERE’S NO ONE LEFT FOR HER TO TRUST!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊!你对 Chinami 撒谎!现在她没有人可以信任了!

lines.en: : Could you keep it down over there? I’m trying to study.
lines.zh: : 你们能小声一点吗?我在学习。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten6
: Study?! For what?! We’re still just-
lines.zh: : 学习?!学什么?!我们明明还只是——

lines.en: : Wizards, I know. But as wizards, shouldn’t it be our responsibility to absorb all of the world’s secrets and not just the ones our parents want us to?
lines.zh: : 巫师,我知道。但作为巫师,吸收世界上所有的秘密、而不只是父母想让我们知道的那些,难道不是我们的责任吗?

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t have parents! They left her and then died respectively!
lines.zh: : Chinami 没有父母!他们先是抛弃了她,然后分别去世了!

lines.en: : Yes, but you have Jeeves now, don’t you? You’re always calling him Papa. And I’m pretty sure I heard your sister call him “Daddy” a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 是,可你现在有 Jeeves 了,不是吗?你一直管他叫爸爸。而且我很确定,几分钟前我听到你姐姐叫他「Daddy」。

lines.en: : She’s probably not supposed to do that! But Chinami still doesn’t know the rules when it comes to adult things!
lines.zh: : 她多半不该那样叫!但 Chinami 在成年人的规则方面,还是什么都不懂!

lines.en: : Oh my God...yes! YES! JUST...LIKE THAT! MASTER! I’M...CUMMING! I’M...FUCKING CUMMING! AAAAAH!
lines.zh: : 我的天……对!对!就……那样!主人!我……要去了!我……他妈的去了!啊啊!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten7
: Chinami wishes she was born deaf instead of just almost sick all the time.
lines.zh: : Chinami 宁愿自己生下来就是聋子,而不是只是经常生病。

lines.en: : They keep talking about “cumming,” but what does that mean?
lines.zh: : 她们一直在说「去了」,可那是什么意思?

lines.en: : I have discerned that it bears no relevance to transportation whatsoever, and that would imply it’s sexual in nature. But how does one sexually arrive?
lines.zh: : 我已经研判出:它与任何交通工具毫无关联,这暗示着它本质上是性的。可是,一个人要如何「性式抵达」?

lines.en: : Chinami! Check the Internet! Google “cumming!”
lines.zh: : Chinami!查网络!Google「去了」!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten8
: No! Chinami doesn’t want to look up naughty words because Tsukasa has decided to be a bad girl!
lines.zh: : 不!Chinami 不想查下流的词,因为 Tsukasa 决定当坏女孩了!

lines.en: : How? It’s not my fault if I just happen to overhear everything your sister is doing with Jeeves in there. It’s their fault for being so loud.
lines.zh: : 怎么是我的错?我碰巧听到你姐姐和 Jeeves 在里面干的一切,又不是我的错。是他们太吵了。

lines.en: : Chinami is gonna give them a piece of her mind too! She just...can’t go in there right now for obvious reasons!
lines.zh: : Chinami 也要去训他们一顿!她只是……眼下出于显而易见的原因进不去!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten9
: Ooh! What if you say you forgot something?! And we both just run in really quickly to grab it? That way, we could see them up close and-
lines.zh: : 哦!要不要说你落了东西?!然后我们俩飞快地冲进去拿?那样,我们就能近距离看到他们,还有——

lines.en: : And burn our eyes out?! Be blinded for life?!
lines.zh: : 然后眼睛烧瞎?!终身失明?!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten10
: Tsk, tsk, Chinami. You must be forgetting that I have already witnessed Jeeves’ “alone time” with another girl.
lines.zh: : 唔啧啧啧,Chinami。你大概忘了,我已经目击过 Jeeves 和另一个女孩的「独处时光」了。

lines.en: : I’m practically an expert at this now. I only want to see it again because science must be tested multiple times.
lines.zh: : 我 practically 已经是这方面的专家了。我想再看一次,只是因为科学必须经过多次验证。

lines.en: : Right...science.
lines.zh: : 对……科学。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten11
: Well, of course. Why else would I take any interest in what Jeeves does with your sister?
lines.zh: : 当然。不然我为什么会对 Jeeves 和你姐姐干的事有兴趣?

lines.en: : Chinami thinks Tsukasa is having an early awakening.
lines.zh: : Chinami 认为,Tsukasa 正在经历早熟的觉醒。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten12
: Am not! Let’s just look up videos instead. I’ve heard of a thing called “pornography” recently that shows men and women-
lines.zh: : 才没有!我们不如改查视频。我最近听说过一个叫「色情制品」的东西,里面有男人和女人——

lines.en: : Chinami knows what pornography is!
lines.zh: : Chinami 知道色情制品是什么!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten13
: No you don’t. You’re the innocent and less smart one here. You can’t possibly know something I don’t.
lines.zh: : 你才不知道。这里天真的、比较笨的是你。你不可能知道我不知道的东西。

lines.en: : Chinami knows lots of things about lots of stuff! But she understands that these things are supposed to be “forbidden knowledge” at her age, so she just pretends she doesn’t!
lines.zh: : Chinami 知道很多很多东西!但她明白,在她的年纪,这些事属于「禁忌知识」,所以她只是假装不知道!

lines.en: : What’s “cumming” then?
lines.zh: : 那「去了」是什么?

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten14
: That one Chinami doesn’t know. But she still thinks you shouldn’t use your computer to find out. Big sis Chika says there’s lots of evil stuff on the Internet.
lines.zh: : 那个 Chinami 真的不知道。但她还是觉得你不该用电脑查。Chika 大姐说,网络上有很多邪恶的东西。

lines.en: : There’s lots of evil stuff outside of the Internet too, Chinami. Our chances of being exploited online are exponentially lower. It’s common sense.
lines.zh: : 网络之外也有很多邪恶的东西,Chinami。我们在网上被剥削的概率要低指数级。这是常识。

lines.en: : You raise a good point...but don’t you think this is kind of bad? We could get into trouble with the...cyber police.
lines.zh: : 你说得有道理……但你不觉得这有点危险吗?我们可能惹上……网络警察。

lines.en: : Mother says the police won’t do anything about a Tsukioka, so you should be safe so long as it’s on my laptop. I’m not really sure where to start looking, though.
lines.zh: : 妈妈说,警察不会对月冈家的人做什么,所以只要用我的笔记本,你就是安全的。不过我倒不知道该从哪查起。

lines.en: : Like, pornography would obviously need to be hidden so children wouldn’t be able to access it, right? So I doubt just searching for the word would work.
lines.zh: : 就是说,色情制品显然需要被藏起来,小孩才无法接触,对吧?所以我怀疑直接搜这个词没用。

lines.en: : Maybe...sex videos?
lines.zh: : 也许……性爱视频?

lines.en: : Chinami thinks that’s still too direct. We might need to be smarter with what we type in.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得还是太直接了。我们输入的内容,可能得更聪明一点。

lines.en: : Any ideas? We should make it a serious first try. I don’t want my computer getting flagged by the cyber-police even if I can bribe them.
lines.zh: : 有主意吗?我们应该认真地完成第一次尝试。我可不想我的电脑被网络警察标记——哪怕我可以贿赂他们。

lines.en: : God, yes! I love it when you fuck me, Daddy! Give it to me! More! More!
lines.zh: : 老天,对!我就爱你干我,爸爸!给我!更多!更多!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten15
: Sister, no! Don’t you know how thin these walls are?! You’re going to burn Chinami’s ears!
lines.zh: : 姐姐,不!你不知道这些墙有多薄吗?!你要把 Chinami 的耳朵烧掉了!

lines.en: : “Boy...fucks...girl.” There. Slang should bypass the filter, right? And I’m pretty sure “fuck” means “sex.” Do you think “cumming” might also be-
lines.zh: : 「男孩……干……女孩。」好了。俚语应该能绕过过滤,对吧?而且我很确定「fuck」就是「性爱」的意思。你觉得「去了」会不会也是——

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten16
: Ah! There it is! Pornhub! I guess the word isn’t banned after all.
lines.zh: : 啊!有了!Pornhub!看来这个词没被封。

lines.en: : What are we supposed to do now, though? Because it says this website is for people over the age of-
lines.zh: : 那我们现在该做什么?因为上面写着这个网站只允许年满——

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten17
: YOU LIED AGAIN AND CLICKED THE WRONG BUTTON! WHO ARE YOU ALL OF A SUDDEN?!
lines.zh: : 你又撒谎点了错误的按钮!你什么时候变成这种人了?!

lines.en: : Oh, Chinami. You’ll never last in the outside world if you aren’t willing to lie to get the things you want. This is what needed to be done. And you’ll be thanking me shortly.
lines.zh: : 哦,Chinami。你不愿意为了想要的东西撒谎的话,在外面世界撑不下去的。这是必须做的事。而且你很快就会感谢我。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten18
: There are so many different options, though. Should we just click on one or search for something specific?
lines.zh: : 可是选项太多了。我们就随便点一个,还是搜具体的内容?

lines.en: : Ch...Chinami will...let Tsukasa choose...
lines.zh: : Ch……Chinami 会……让 Tsukasa 来选……

lines.en: : She’s going to look...the opposite way so her eyes don’t bleed.
lines.zh: : 她会把头……扭到另一边,免得眼睛流血。

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll just try searching for girls our age? There’s probably something on here that-
lines.zh: : 也许我试试搜「我们这个年纪的女孩」?这里面应该有——

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten19
: Aren’t you supposed to be smart?! You definitely can’t do that! You’ll get put on some kind of list!
lines.zh: : 你不是很聪明吗?!你 absolutely 不能搜那个!你会被写进什么名单的!

lines.en: : A list? Like...what kind of list?
lines.zh: : 名单?就……什么样的名单?

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know! That’s why she said “some” kind of list! Just click on one! With adults!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道!所以她才说「某种」名单!随便点一个!有成年人的!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten20
: Fine, jeez. Then how about...oh! Here we go. “Hung Stud Fucks GF’s Little Sister. MASSIVE Cock & LOADS of Cum.” So that’s how it’s spelled.
lines.zh: : 行,天。那这个怎么样……哦!有了。「猛男干翻女友的妹妹。巨物与滚滚浓精。」原来这个词是这么拼的。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...Chinami still thinks this is a bad idea...Big sis Chika will kill both of us if she finds out.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……Chinami 还是觉得这是个坏主意……Chika 大姐发现了会杀了我们两个的。

lines.en: : Stop being a scaredy-cat. Just don’t let her find out and we’ll be fine. Click.
lines.zh: : 别当胆小鬼。只要别让她发现,我们就没事。点。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten21
: Aaaah! Chinami is going to Hell if Hell is real! But at least she’ll still be able to see Tsukasa there!
lines.zh: : 啊!如果地狱真的存在,Chinami 要下地狱了!但至少她还能在那里见到 Tsukasa!

lines.en: : Chinami, calm down. It’s important that we approach this with some level of civility so we can keep a level head when the time comes for us to-
lines.zh: : Chinami,冷静。我们得带着一定程度的文明去接触这件事,这样到了关键时刻,我们才能保持清醒的头脑——

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten22
: OH MY GOD?! WHAT IS THAT?! IT’S GIGANTIC!
lines.zh: : 我的天?!那是什么?!巨大无比!

lines.en: : Already?! There wasn’t even any dialogue! Why did they give the movie a title at all?!
lines.zh: : 这就开始了?!连一句对白都没有!那他们给电影起标题干什么?!

lines.en: : Is that his penis? It’s like six inches long! They can get that big?!
lines.zh: : 那是他的 penis?差不多六英寸长!它们能长那么大?!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten23
: N...Not that Chinami actually cares or...is interested in any capacity, which she definitely is not — but is that bigger than Papa’s was when you saw it?
lines.zh: : 才……才不是 Chinami 真的在乎、或者有任何兴趣——她绝对没有——但那比你见到爸爸的时候大吗?

lines.en: : I was kind of far away and I couldn’t really get a good look at it...not like I actually cared or had any interest either, so...maybe? I’m not...sure.
lines.zh: : 我当时离得有点远,没怎么看清……倒不是我真的在乎或者有兴趣,所以……也许?我不……确定。

lines.en: : And you won’t volunteer to go back into your apartment with me, so there is a chance we’ll never know unless your sister tells us for some reason.
lines.zh: : 而你又不愿意主动和我回你公寓,所以有一种可能,我们永远都不会知道——除非你姐姐因为某种原因告诉我们。

lines.en: : Or if he “fucks” us instead since there’s a clear precedent of that happening based on the title of this movie.
lines.zh: : 又或者他反过来「干」我们——因为从这部电影的标题看,这种事有明确的先例。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten24
: ABSOLUTELY NOT! NEVER! PAPA WOULDN’T!
lines.zh: : 绝对不行!永远不会!爸爸不会的!

lines.en: : But in the event that he would...would you?
lines.zh: : 可万一他会呢……你会吗?

lines.en: : No! Chinami loves him, but not like that!
lines.zh: : 不!Chinami 爱他,但不是那种爱!

lines.en: : I’m just saying, Chinami, it sounds like your sister is having the time of her life right now. Have you ever felt that good about literally anything ever?
lines.zh: : 我只是说,Chinami,听起来你姐姐此刻正度过她人生最快乐的时光。你对任何东西有过那种感觉吗?

lines.en: : Probably not! But that doesn’t mean I’m going to do it with my sister’s boyfriend! Who is also kind of my dad!
lines.zh: : 多半没有!但这不代表我要和我姐姐的男朋友做!他多少还算我半个爸!

lines.en: : You have an older sister too! Are you telling me you’d do it with my Papa if you overheard them?!
lines.zh: : 你也有个姐姐!你是说,如果你偷听到她们俩,你就会和我爸做?!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten25
: Not if his is as big as that guy’s. That just sounds like it would hurt. This girl seems to be enjoying it, though. And she’s a little sister too, so who knows?
lines.zh: : 要是他那根和视频里那根一样大,就不做。听着就疼。不过这个女孩看起来很享受。她也是妹妹,所以谁知道呢?

lines.en: : Ch...Chinami just doesn’t understand why you’re so obsessed with dirty stuff all of a sudden. She misses when we just played games.
lines.zh: : Ch……Chinami 只是不明白,你为什么突然迷恋上这些下流的东西。她怀念我们只是玩游戏的时候。

lines.en: : That’s very rude to the actors, Chinami. They worked hard on this. You can tell by how much they’re sweating.
lines.zh: : 这样说对演员们很不礼貌,Chinami。他们很努力。你看他们出了多少汗就知道。

lines.en: : I still haven’t seen any “cum,” though. Does it just happen on the inside, maybe? Chinami, fetch my notebook. I want to write down some questions I have for Jeeves. He’ll help me.
lines.zh: : 可我还是没见到任何「精液」。也许它只在体内发生?Chinami,把我的笔记本拿来。我要写下几个想问 Jeeves 的问题。他会帮我的。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten26
: Chinami begs you to not ask her Papa any questions about this. You have already made her big sister uncomfortable. He is all I have left.
lines.zh: : Chinami 恳求你不要问她爸爸任何关于这个的问题。你已经让她的大姐姐很不自在了。他是她仅剩的一切。

lines.en: : Jeeves won’t be uncomfortable answering my questions, though. He’s a teacher.
lines.zh: : 但 Jeeves 回答我的问题不会不自在。他是老师。

lines.en: : And for all we know, those two really are studying in there. Mother always said his methods were unorthodox after all.
lines.zh: : 而且谁知道呢,说不定他们俩真的在里面学习。妈妈不是常说,他的方法 unconventional 吗。

lines.en: : Besides, he’s done it in the same room as me before. And probably made eye contact with me. I think. Who else can I ask?
lines.zh: : 再说了,他以前在和我同一个房间的时候做过一次。多半还和我对视了。我想。我还能问谁?

lines.en: : Your mom! Like big sis Chika said!
lines.zh: : 你妈妈!就像 Chika 大姐说的!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten27
: I can’t.
lines.zh: : 我做不到。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Because she’s already trying to arrange a marriage for me. Asking her questions about sex now might make her speed up the process.
lines.zh: : 因为她已经在给我安排联姻了。现在问她关于性的问题,只会让她加速进程。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten28
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Oh, the little sister’s on top now. That looks far more comfortable.
lines.zh: : 哦,妹妹骑到上面了。那看起来舒服多了。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, what did you just say?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,你刚才说什么?

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten29
: That the little sister is on top and it looks far more comfortable. You’d know that too if you’d just look at the screen and stop being so afraid of normal human functions.
lines.zh: : 妹妹骑到了上面,那看起来舒服多了。你要是肯看一眼屏幕、别再害怕正常的人类机能,你也知道。

lines.en: : Not about that...I meant the other thing.
lines.zh: : 不是那个……我是说另一件事。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten30
: Oh. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。

lines.en: : My mom’s trying to set up an arranged marriage. It’s a pretty normal thing in rich families. And it’ll help her get rid of me faster, so...
lines.zh: : 我妈妈正在给我安排一桩联姻。在有钱人的家庭里,这很正常。而且这还能让她更快摆脱我,所以……

lines.en: : Are you serious?
lines.zh: : 你是认真的?

lines.en: : Mhm. And I’m not sure how old the guy will be yet, but if he’s an adult, I don’t want to be blindsided by not knowing what I’m doing when it comes to all this stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我还不知道对方多大,但如果他是成年人,我不想在两眼一抹黑、什么都不懂的情况下被动接受这一切。

lines.en: : That’s...the thing you’re worried about? Not...knowing what to do?
lines.zh: : 你……担心的是这个?不是……不知道该怎么做?

lines.en: : It’s not the only thing. I’m worried about a bunch of stuff. Like if he’s mean. What his house looks like. If I can bring my henchmen.
lines.zh: : 不只是这个。我担心一大堆事。比如他人坏不坏。他家长什么样。我能不能带我的手下。

lines.en: : This is the one thing I can control, though. So if I know all of this stuff by the time we’re married, it’ll be one less thing to worry about.
lines.zh: : 但这是唯一一件我能掌控的事。所以等结婚的时候,只要这些都懂了,担心的事就少一件。

lines.en: : And you’re...okay with this?
lines.zh: : 你就……接受这一切?

lines.en: : It’s my duty. And...
lines.zh: : 那是我的职责。而且……

lines.en: : The first chance I’ve ever had to be useful.
lines.zh: : 这是我人生中第一次有机会「有用」。

lines.en: scene black
scene tsukasachinamilisten31
: But...But you’re Chinami’s age. You can’t get married yet. That’s not legal, she doesn’t think.
lines.zh: : 可是……可你跟 Chinami 同岁。你不能结婚。那是违法的,她觉得。

lines.en: : I don’t know the logistics of it. I just know that it’s been happening for hundreds of years and that it’ll continue to happen long after the two of us are gone.
lines.zh: : 我不知道具体怎么操作。我只知道这种事已经延续了几百年,而且在我们俩都化为尘土之后还会继续。

lines.en: : Why would your mom do that, though? She can’t just...give you away. Why would she give you away? You guys are the richest family in Kumon-mi, aren’t you? What can you gain by-
lines.zh: : 可你妈妈为什么要那样做?她不能随便……把你送走。她为什么要送走你?你们是 Kumon-mi 最有钱的家族,不是吗?这样能得到什么——

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten32
: Oh, that’s cum! Eww...It looks kind of gross.
lines.zh: : 哦,那是精液!好恶心……看起来有点吓人。

lines.en: : Tsukasa! This is serious!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa!这很严肃!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten33
: I know it’s serious, okay?! But there’s nothing I can do about it! And chances are, I don’t have the answers to 99%% of your questions so please, just drop it!
lines.zh: : 我知道这很严肃,行吗?!但我无能为力!而且,你 99%% 的问题我多半都答不上来,所以求你了,别问了!

lines.en: : There’s nothing you can do?! You can’t say no?! To what happens to your own life?!
lines.zh: : 你无能为力?!你不能说「不」吗?!对你自己的人生?!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten34
: I mean...
lines.zh: : 就是说……

lines.en: : I can.
lines.zh: : 我可以。

lines.en: : But why would I?...
lines.zh: : 可我为什么要呢?……

lines.en: : Onee-sama is the family’s heir. No one in the manor cares about me. And Mother was part of an arranged marriage too when she was younger.
lines.zh: : Onee-sama 是家族的继承人。公馆里没有人在乎我。而妈妈年轻时,也是一桩联姻的产物。

lines.en: : She’s the most powerful woman in the whole city now...Something I will never be.
lines.zh: : 她如今是全城最有权力的女人……我永远成不了的那种。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten35
: But I need to be something.
lines.zh: : 但我需要成为「某种东西」。

lines.en: : The name “Tsukioka” is far too big for a walking back-up plan like me...
lines.zh: : 「月冈」这个姓氏,对一个像我这样会走路的备用计划来说,太大了……

lines.en: : So maybe a new one will suit me better?
lines.zh: : 所以,也许换个姓更适合我?

lines.en: scene black
scene tsukasachinamilisten36
: Wait, why are you crying? You’re not the one who has to marry some random person.
lines.zh: : 等等,你哭什么?要随便嫁人的又不是你。

lines.en: : Because that’s the saddest thing I’ve ever heard! And I’ve heard a lot of sad things, Tsukasa! A lot!
lines.zh: : 因为这是我听过的最悲伤的事!我听过很多悲伤的事,Tsukasa!很多!

lines.en: : I don’t doubt that. Your life is pretty horrible compared to mine. And there are tons of people who would jump at the opportunity to marry into some rich family.
lines.zh: : 这我不怀疑。和我的人生比起来,你的确实挺惨。而且有大量的人,会抢着嫁进某个有钱人家。

lines.en: : You’re not one of them, though! You don’t actually want this! You’re just doing it because it’s expected of you! And I...Chinami doesn’t think that’s fair!
lines.zh: : 但你不是那种人!你其实不想要这个!你只是在履行别人对你的期待!而我……Chinami 不觉得这公平!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten37
: Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Without knowing what I do want...there’s no point trying to fight back against the life that was chosen for me.
lines.zh: : 在不知道我「真正想要什么」之前,反抗这条被别人替我选好的人生,毫无意义。

lines.en: : If I can do that right, at least I can contribute something to the family before I’m gone...
lines.zh: : 如果这件事我能做好,至少在我离开之前,我还能为家族贡献点什么……

lines.en: : Chinami will find a way...to keep you here.
lines.zh: : Chinami 会想办法……把你留在这里的。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten38
: She promises...
lines.zh: : 她保证……

lines.en: : She shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 她不应该保证。

lines.en: : But she does...because she knows this isn’t what Tsukasa wants.
lines.zh: : 但她保证……因为她知道,这不是 Tsukasa 想要的。

lines.en: : And she is going to find a way to protect her even if Tsukasa doesn’t want her to.
lines.zh: : 而且就算 Tsukasa 不希望她管,她也会找到保护她的办法。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten39
: On a...brighter note...I think your sister and Jeeves might finally be done? Or at least...taking a break?
lines.zh: : 说点……好消息……你姐姐和 Jeeves 好像终于结束了?或者至少……在休息?

lines.en: : Big sis Chika probably killed him...she’s crazy now and sounded very scary with all of her yelling.
lines.zh: : Chika 大姐多半把他杀了……她现在疯疯癫癫的,吼起来吓死人了。

lines.en: : Well...at least Jeeves died doing what he loved.
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少 Jeeves 死于他所热爱的事业。

lines.en: scene black
: I just wish I got to ask him some of my questions first...
lines.zh: : 我只是希望,能先问他几个我的问题……
